description: This source file defines an enumeration of font weight values and a static class providing predefined font weights, conversion methods, and utilities related to font weights within the PdfSharp.Drawing namespace.

classes.name: XFontWeights
classes.description: Provides static properties representing predefined font weights and methods for font weight conversion and parsing.

methods.name: FontWeightStringToKnownWeight
methods.description: Converts a string representation of a font weight to an XFontWeight object if recognized.

methods.name: FontWeightToString
methods.description: Converts an integer font weight to its string representation if known.

methods.name: FontWeightFromFaceName
methods.description: Extracts a font weight from a font face name string by parsing known weight keywords.
